faq_heading: Homes near Glenwood Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Glenwood Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Glenwood Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Glenwood Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Glenwood Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are St Catherines School (1.8 km north-west), Noel Booth Elementary (2.3 km north-west) and Brookswood Secondary (2.7 km north).

Glenwood Elementary is an elementary school in Langley (Langley School District), at 20785 24 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Glenwood Elementary in the listing.
How the Glenwood Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Glenwood Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. Ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 5 km of Glenwood Elementary

11 schools in the provincial school list sit within 5 km of Glenwood Elementary in a straight line (7 elementary, 2 other, 1 secondary, 1 middle; 1 independent). The closest is St Catherines School, 1.8 km away, and the farthest on this list is H D Stafford Middle, 5.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Brookswood Secondary (2.7 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Noel Booth Elementary (2.3 km). Other elementary schools close by: St Catherines School (1.8 km north-west), Noel Booth Elementary (2.3 km north-west), Belmont Elementary (3.2 km north), Uplands Elementary (4.1 km north), Alice Brown Elementary (4.3 km north). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is St Catherines School, 1.8 km north-west of Glenwood Elementary.
